project: TN-Check: CSL Model Checking on Tensor-Train CME
description: Maps every paper claim to its proof, artifact, or code reference.

claims.claim: For Metzler generators, L1 error is non-increasing under the semigroup: ||e^{Qt}(p - p̃)||₁ ≤ ||p - p̃||₁
Axis-aligned predicates preserve bond dimension: χ(1_Φ ⊙ p) ≤ χ(p)
Linear predicates c^T x ≤ b can be evaluated on MPS with bond dimension increase ≤ N
Post-truncation clamping of negative entries never increases L1 error: ||clamp(p̃) - p||₁ ≤ ||p̃ - p||₁
CSL model checking on TT costs O(N·d·χ³·|Φ|) per time step
Three sufficient conditions for bounded TT rank: (i) product-form stationary distribution, (ii) weak coupling with ε-perturbation, (iii) area-law entanglement entropy S ≤ c·log(χ)
||Δp||₁ ≤ √(2·K_eff) · ∫||res(t)||_F dt, where K_eff is effective support size
MPO compression ratio grows exponentially: 6.2× at N=2 to 7.8×10¹³ at N=10
claims.numerical_verification: Run: python3 -c "from tn_check.experiments import run_scaling_experiment; run_scaling_experiment()"

claims.claim: Bond dimension χ=10 achieves L1 error 1.62×10⁻¹² on gene expression model
claims.numerical_verification: Run: python3 -c "from tn_check.experiments import run_compression_experiment; run_compression_experiment()"

claims.claim: Zero verdict disagreements across 30 CSL properties on 10 models; 22 agree, 8 indeterminate, 0 disagree
Entanglement entropy analysis confirms area-law scaling (S_max < 3.0) across all 20 tested models; deficiency analysis provides rigorous rank-1 guarantees for 8 networks
Cumulative clamping bias grows linearly (not exponentially) and remains <5% of truncation error
TDVP backward error analysis shows Frobenius residuals bounded by O(dt²) with L1-from-Frobenius bound tight within factor 2
claims.numerical_verification: Run: analyze_tdvp_convergence() and check frobenius_residual field

claims.claim: 51 biological models compile to valid MPO generators and produce well-formed probability distributions
claims.numerical_verification: All model builders produce valid ReactionNetwork objects with correct stoichiometry

claims.claim: Automated numerical verification of all theoretical claims across randomized model instances
claims.numerical_verification: Run: python3 -c "from tn_check.evaluation.math_rigor import run_full_rigor_suite; run_full_rigor_suite()"

claims.claim: Certificate pipeline produces SOUND verdicts with total errors ≤ 2.38×10⁻²
claims.numerical_verification: Run: CertifiedVerifier.verify() on gene expression model

claims.claim: Networks with deficiency δ=0 and weak reversibility have product-form stationary distributions with TT rank 1; provides graph-theoretic sufficient condition for compressibility
Total L1 error ≤ ε_FSP + Σε_TT + √(2K_eff)·Σr_k·Δt with linear (not exponential) accumulation due to Metzler contractivity
Clamping bias is always mass-adding; P≥p verdicts may have false TRUE risk, P≤p verdicts are conservative/sound
PRISM-format model files (.pm) and CSL property files (.csl) generated for all benchmark models for external validation
claims.numerical_verification: Run: export_storm_benchmark() to generate .pm and .csl files
